items.title: Qwen Code Desktop v0.29.0
items.en_oneliner: Qwen Code Desktop reaches 0.29.0 with steadier background observation and suspend-safe recovery for managed agents, paged transcript history, a pre-auth entry for artifact routes, an extra-high reasoning tier for Gemini 4 Neon and Hydrogen, and automatic reasoning defaults on Kimi K3 routes.

items.title: SDK TypeScript Release v0.1.40
items.en_oneliner: Qwen Code's TypeScript SDK is out at v0.1.40, bundling CLI 0.29.0 so developers can call on Qwen Code capabilities directly from their projects.

items.title: Release v0.29.0
items.en_oneliner: If the Broker fails over mid-task, the hosted Harness now picks up the interrupted Turn again after confirming its saved progress and outcome.

items.title: Release v0.29.0-preview.0
items.en_oneliner: This preview release mainly fixes session recovery and skill admission for managed agents, adds a two-member pool for hosted harnesses, and moves the web session list onto a shared chat surface.

items.title: v2.77.0 (2026-11-27)
items.en_oneliner: Pydantic AI 2.77.0 adds SQLite, Postgres and MongoDB backends for conversation storage, renames the session store, skips missing skill libraries by default with advice, and makes cross-provider thinking summaries easier to read.
